cpu.description: Eight rounds of bounded integer arithmetic per event; CPU control.

records.description: Build records, retain originals, enrich copies, filter and reduce both versions.

snapshots.description: Update a 256-key map; retain a snapshot every 64 updates; read all versions.

handoff.description: One producer and one consumer; bounded queue of 256 scalar values.

batches.description: Same values in fixed 64-item batches; four queued batches; includes partial tail.
